notes: MA33. Verified against catalog.ucsd.edu/curric/ECON-ug.html. Joint major administered by both the Mathematics and Economics departments. Upper-division requires 15 courses total, with a minimum of 7 from one department and 8 from the other. Several requirements are choose-one-of chains. Confidence raised from medium to high after catalog corroboration; all buckets match the catalog exactly.

buckets.label: Lower-division Mathematics
buckets.note: MATH 20A-B-C-D plus MATH 18 (linear algebra); the honors path MATH 31AH-BH with MATH 20D may substitute. Effectively 5 lower-division math courses forming the calculus + linear algebra foundation.

buckets.label: Real analysis / advanced calculus foundation
buckets.note: MATH 109 (mathematical reasoning) required; may be substituted with a four-unit upper-division MATH elective if MATH 31CH was completed.

buckets.label: Applied linear algebra / probability elective
buckets.note: One course from MATH 102, MATH 170A, or the MATH 100A-B sequence.

buckets.label: Real analysis (first course)
buckets.note: One course from MATH 140A or MATH 142A.

buckets.label: Analysis / topology (second course)
buckets.note: One course from MATH 130, MATH 140B, or MATH 142B.

buckets.label: Econometrics / probability-statistics option
buckets.note: Choose one option: (a) ECON 120A-B-C; OR (b) MATH 180A + ECON 120B-C; OR (c) MATH 180A + MATH 181A-B + ECON 120C. 'needed' counts a representative 3-course path; the third option totals more courses.

buckets.label: Macroeconomics / mathematical modeling option
buckets.note: Choose one option: ECON 110A-B; OR MATH 171A-B; OR ECON 172A-B; OR ECON 171 + ECON 172A.
